findings.text: blocking: audit_finding_for returns before repeated_token_check when audit_report is None, and _item_record at :571 marks the check unanswered; the receipt call in srtj-noul-polarity-run.py:337 supplies no report, so removing its Jev question leaves this check undecided in the measured arm and in a default review_names call.

blocking: the report encodes an abandoned property-only validation probe as well as a corrected validation read, and the fragment acknowledges exposure before correction; the done_when requires validation to be read once after calibration, so this arm cannot establish that holdout measure without a fresh independent validation cohort.

follow-on: the COCOS test supplies psi_like inside its own dd_source_docs fixture, so deleting the DD reader enrichment at srtj-evidence-supply-run.py:108-129 leaves the assertion green; add a reader-bound test or control to protect that connection.
follow-on: all pending Jev requests are scheduled before the USD 0.50 check at :203, so the ceiling can be exceeded by in-flight requests even though this recorded arm spent only USD 0.165378.
